chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you perform salat (prayer) while facing other than the qiblah, and it becomes clear to you that you performed salat (prayer) while facing other than the qiblah, and you are still within the time, then repeat it. But if the time has passed, then do not repeat it.

key_terms.غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ: other than the direction of the qiblah
key_terms.وَقْتٍ: the prescribed time of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone discovers after praying that they faced other than the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who discovers that he performed salat (prayer) facing other than the qiblah. If he realizes this within the prescribed time, he must repeat the prayer; if the time has already passed, he does not repeat it.
